s2-a.text: My name is Nisha. I'm twelve.

s2-b.text: I live in Mirpur Khas with Papa, Amil, and Dadi.

s2-d.text: So I'm going to write to you every night.

s3-world.text: For almost a hundred years, Britain ruled India. Hindus, Muslims, Sikhs, and Christians lived side by side, in the same towns and on the same streets.

s4-names.text: In 1947, India won its freedom. But its leaders could not agree on what that freedom would look like.

s5-line.text: A British lawyer who had never been to India drew the border in about five weeks.

s6-movement.text: Almost overnight, millions of people found themselves on the wrong side of a line.

s7-a.text: Papa says we are Hindu, so we have to leave.

s7-b.text: But Mama, you were Muslim. So what am I?
